title: These are awful
text: These are awful. I would love these plates. They are nice and thick A huge problem is they are so smooth that most foods we put on them slide around because of the texture of the plate. Nothing sticks to these plates and that's not always a good thing. Bringing full plates to the table is a balancing act. Get different plates.
